run_dm_control_explorer: run the dm_control suite explorer to interactively browse and visualize available reinforcement learning environments
run_explorer_with_environment: run the dm_control explorer with a specific domain.task environment name via the environment_name flag
run_explorer_with_action_noise: run the dm_control explorer with Gaussian action noise applied as a fraction of the action range
run_explorer_without_timeout: run the dm_control explorer with episode time limits disabled by setting the timeout flag to false
run_explorer_with_reward_visualization: run the dm_control explorer with reward visualization enabled to color geoms by current reward value
